    All Publix store locations and pharmacies will be
    closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026. The chain closes only for three holidays annually—Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day—to allow employees to spend time with family. Stores will resume regular business hours on Monday, April 6. 
    • Saturday, April 4: Open, regular hours.
    • Sunday, April 5 (Easter): Closed.
    • Monday, April 6: Open, regular hours. 
    If you need groceries on Easter Sunday, other retailers like Walmart and some Whole Foods Market locations may be open.

    Is Publix closed during Easter?
    Which holidays are Publix stores closed? Publix stores are closed three days a year: Thanksgiving, Christmas and Easter. We also close early on Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve and New Year's Day; the times are posted in our stores prior to the holidays.
